worldcombat.skill.flatter.summary: Flatter the target, raising its Special Attack and pinning it briefly; the daze makes its attempts fumble and its landed hits recoil on itself.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.0: Make a hard-hitting foe fumble and hurt itself
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.1: Pin an opponent the instant before it closes in
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.2: Add fuel to an already faltering enemy
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.0: Flatter the target senseless: it gains %1$s Special Attack stages (its moves hit harder and its recoil is heavier), is pinned in place and unable to move for %2$s s, then left dazed for about %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.1: While dazed, each attempt has a %1$s%% chance to be lost in a daze; each time it lands a hit on a non-ally it suffers pride recoil for about %2$s%% of its maximum health, multiplied by 0.4-2.5 by its current Special Attack.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s, range %4$s blocks. A rapid patter adds to the gift and fumble chance and deepens the recoil but shortens the daze; a slow tribute does the opposite.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.timing: Short windup and recovery; accurate and single target, paced by its cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.preference.ton: Rapid patter: gift +1 stage, fumble chance +12%%, recoil x1.3, but daze x0.7. Slow tribute: daze x1.35 and recoil x0.7, for a long grind.
Only consider flattering a threat within this distance; larger opens earlier.
Prefer to flatter while the target is still this far away, using its daze to open space; closer targets only follow the normal order.
When on, the companion leaves its post to flatter.
